heard.who: Kathmandu Post, 8 December 2020, on the figure accepted before the new survey
heard.quote: The earlier accepted height was 8,848 metres or 29,028 feet.

answer: Not exactly any more. In December 2020 Nepal and China jointly announced the official height as 8,848.68 metres, a little above the 8,848 metres Nepal had used since a 1950s survey. China's earlier figure was about four metres lower because it measured the rock, not the snow cap.

facts.text: In December 2020 Nepal and China jointly announced the official height of Mount Everest as 8,848.68 metres above sea level.

sources.title: Everest Gets A Growth Spurt As China, Nepal Revise Official Elevation Upward
sources.quote: Officials say the summit now stands precisely at 8,848.86 meters, or 29,031.69 feet above sea level.

sources.title: It's official: Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres tall
sources.quote: The new height of Mt Everest is 8,848.86 metres.

sources.title: It's official: Everest grows almost a metre after China and Nepal settle a long-running debate
sources.quote: The new figure - 8,848.86 metres (29,031.7ft) - raises the previous highest estimate by 86cm.

facts.text: Before 2020 Nepal's official figure was 8,848 metres, from a Survey of India measurement in the early 1950s, and China's figure was about four metres lower because it counted the rock summit, not the snow cap.

sources.title: Mt Everest: Nepal, China announce revised height at 8,849 metres
sources.quote: Nepal earlier recognised 8,848 metres as Mount Everest's official snow height which was the finding of a survey conducted by the Survey of India in the early 1950s.

sources.title: It's official: Everest grows almost a metre after China and Nepal settle a long-running debate
sources.quote: China had previously set the figure 4 metres lower than that because it counted the summit's rock base, while Nepal included the snowcap.

sources.title: Everest Gets A Growth Spurt As China, Nepal Revise Official Elevation Upward
sources.quote: held until 1955, when an Indian survey reestablished the number at 29,029 feet

contested.text: Whether any single figure can be the height, because the mountain itself changes: tectonic uplift raises it and the 2015 earthquake may have lowered it.

sources.title: Everest Gets A Growth Spurt As China, Nepal Revise Official Elevation Upward
sources.quote: The actual mountain is moving, thanks to geological forces such as plate tectonics slowly thrusting it upward and the massive 2015 earthquake that possibly made it shorter

could_not_verify: The Nepal Survey Department's own technical report; only news accounts of the announcement were read.
How the 2020 figure treats snow depth in detail; the pages do not say.
not_claimed: That the mountain's height is fixed.
That Nepal and China measured it as a single joint team; the pages describe two survey teams.
